title: MobileGrail: Learning Compact Guardrails for On-Device deployable Mobile GUI Agent Safety
abstract: arXiv:2611.29847v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Runtime guardrails protect mobile GUI agents by assessing each proposed action before execution, but existing guardrails rely on cloud hosted large multimodal models, exposing every screen to a remote server, including private information such as payments, messages, and medical records. We propose MobileGrail, an on-device deployable model that addresses both. It maintains a recurrent task state that retains only the evidence subsequent safety decisions depend on, so that authorization and execution progress persist beyond the short context. To intervene early while keeping the safety boundary precise, it learns two labels, unsafe and block: unsafe marks the action that commits a violation, whereas block may be issued at any step of an intervention window, which spans from the first action that the user's authorization no longer explains to the committing action itself. translated_title: MobileGrail：为可端侧部署的移动GUI智能体安全学习紧凑型防护栏
translated_abstract: 运行时防护栏通过在执行前评估每个拟议操作来保护移动GUI智能体，但现有防护栏依赖云端托管的大型多模态模型，会将每一块屏幕内容（包括支付、消息和医疗记录等隐私信息）暴露给远程服务器。我们提出了MobileGrail，一个可端侧部署的模型，同时解决了上述两个问题。它维护一个循环任务状态，仅保留后续安全决策所依赖的证据，使授权情况和执行进度能够超越短上下文而持续存在。为了在保持安全边界精确的同时尽早干预，它学习两个标签：unsafe（不安全）和block（阻断）：unsafe标记实施违规的那个操作，而block可以在干预窗口内的任意步骤发出，该干预窗口从用户授权不再能解释的第一个操作开始，一直延续到实施违规的操作本身。为支持训练，我们构建了一个包含32个应用的环境……
tldr: MobileGrail提出了一种可端侧部署的紧凑型防护栏模型，通过循环任务状态和unsafe/block双标签机制，在避免屏幕隐私信息上传云端的同时，对移动GUI智能体实现尽早且精确的安全干预。
en_tdlr: MobileGrail introduces a compact on-device guardrail for mobile GUI agents that leverages a recurrent task state and dual unsafe/block labels to enable early yet precise safety intervention while keeping sensitive screen content from being exposed to remote servers.
